feeding_claim.verbatim: Our cattle are 100% pasture-raised, grass-fed, and grass-finished

notes: Historic cattle ranch in Waimea (Kamuela) on the Big Island. Sells beef directly through its online shop as beef boxes and monthly or bimonthly subscriptions, shipped frozen and vacuum sealed in insulated boxes by FedEx and UPS; the FAQ names no shipping area, so ships_to is left empty. Beef is also sold at the Waimea Butcher Shop, all KTA Superstores, Target stores in Hawaii, and Tamura's Waianae. The Waimea store itself sells only branded merchandise, not beef. No quarter, half, or whole shares found.
